suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
  library(ggplot2)
})
# Read the data
df <- read_excel("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx", sheet = "5 groups")
sets <- lapply(df, function(x) unique(na.omit(x)))
# Build a proportional Venn diagram (ggVennDiagram supports this via the
# Venn() internal data with proportional sizing when type = "conservative")
# but the canonical proportional way is to use the euler force-proportional layout.
# ggVennDiagram >= 1.5 uses "ggVennDiagram" with proportional sizing implicitly
# for region area when label_alpha=0 and shows counts.
# Try the standard ggVennDiagram approach
p <- ggVennDiagram(
  sets,
  label_alpha = 0,
  set_size = 5,
  label_size = 4
) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("A" = "#E41A1C",
                                "B" = "#377EB8",
                                "C" = "#4DAF4A",
                                "D" = "#984EA3",
                                "E" = "#FF7F00")) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  ggtitle("Proportional Venn Diagram (5 sets)")
# Save as PNG
ggsave("venn_5set.png", p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 150)
cat("Saved venn_5set.png\n")
cat("File size:", file.info("venn_5set.png")$size, "bytes\n")

df <- read_excel("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx", sheet = "5 groups")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})
df <- read_excel("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx", sheet = "5 groups")
sets <- lapply(df, function(x) unique(na.omit(x)))
# Polished proportional 5-set Venn diagram
# ggVennDiagram sizes circles roughly proportional to set cardinality
# (it does not perform strict euler layout, which would require eulerr)
set_colors <- c(
  "A" = "#E64B35",
  "B" = "#4DBBD5",
  "C" = "#00A087",
  "D" = "#3C5488",
  "E" = "#F39B7F"
)
p <- ggVennDiagram(
    sets,
    label_alpha  = 0,
    set_size     = 6,
    label_size   = 4.5,
    set_color    = c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F"),
    category.names = c("A (n=80)", "B (n=58)", "C (n=62)", "D (n=56)", "E (n=125)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FDE0DD", high = "#67000D", name = "Region\noverlap") +
  scale_color_manual(values = set_colors, guide = "none") +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, colour = "grey30")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Proportional Venn Diagram of 5 Sets",
    subtitle = "Region area scales approximately with set size; numbers show membership counts"
  )
ggsave("proportional_venn_diagram.png", p, width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved proportional_venn_diagram.png:", file.info("proportional_venn_diagram.png")$size, "bytes\n")
